propositions: Changing a ticket's type silently carries forward a plan-review verdict that was computed under different criteria, because material_fingerprint and reuse checks do not account for ticket_type
Plan-review scoring is gated on ticket_type in four places (bug exemptions), so a plan that passes as bug but would block as task is replayed as pass when retyped
Both reuse paths (idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse) compare stored material fingerprint and code SHA but never check if stored ticket_type matches current ticket_type
The REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already records ticket_type, so no schema change is needed to add the type comparison guard
The fix compares stored and current ticket_type in both reuse paths and fails open (allows reuse) when either value is absent or empty, preserving attestations written before the change
